title: A Constitutional False Claims Act
Reconciling Regulatory Impact Analyses and Agencies' Statutory Mandates for Environmental Regulations under Loper Bright
abstract: Federal administrative agencies frequently undertake regulatory impact analyses to provide the basis for promulgating new regulations and justify the reasonableness of regulations upon judicial review. Using the best available analytical methods, agencies quantify and compare the relative costs and benefits of regulatory alternatives, seeking policies that maximize net societal benefits, subject to statutory constraints. Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo threatens to upend this methodological check on the rationality of agency action in two distinct ways: first by limiting the permissibility of regulatory impact analysis as a basis for regulation, and second by replacing technical and scientific-informed components of the analysis with judicial interpretations of ambiguous statutory provisions. This threat is most unsettling in the context of environmental regulations, which comprise the greatest share of new federal regulations. The monetization of environmental harms is essential to demonstrate that the benefits of remedial regulations outweigh their costs, and the promulgation of new regulations to confront emerging climatic issues frequently relies on ambiguous statutory provisions. This article explores the far-reaching effects of Loper Bright that go to the analytical foundations of policy analysis and evaluation. It argues that assessing the impact of Loper Bright requires consideration not only of the consistency between regulatory policies and the agency’s enabling statute but also of the harmony between the underlying justification for regulations and the statutory prescriptions regarding the factors that should be considered in regulatory policy design. The article concludes that, while judicial review will become more scrutinizing of the compatibility between agencies’ statutory mandate and the substantive policies underlying regulatory impact analysis, the regulatory state can—and indeed must—evolve or else risk ossification.
abstract_zh: 联邦行政机构经常开展监管影响分析，为颁布新法规提供依据，并在司法审查中论证法规的合理性。机构运用最佳可得的分析方法，量化并比较各项监管备选方案的相对成本与收益，在法定约束的前提下寻求使社会净收益最大化的政策。Loper Bright Enterprises诉Raimondo案的判决以两种截然不同的方式威胁到这一对机构行为合理性的方法性制约：一是限制将监管影响分析作为监管依据的可允许性；二是以对模糊法定条款的司法解释，取代分析中以技术和科学为基础的组成部分。这一威胁在环境监管领域尤为令人不安，因为环境监管在联邦新法规中所占比例最大。环境危害的货币化对于证明补救性监管的收益超过其成本至关重要，而为应对新出现的气候问题而颁布的新法规，也经常依赖于模糊的法定条款。本文探讨了Loper Bright案的深远影响，这些影响触及政策分析与评估的分析基础。文章认为，评估Loper Bright案的影响，不仅需要考虑监管政策与机构授权法之间的一致性，还需要考虑监管政策设计的基本理由与法定规定所要求考虑的因素之间的协调性。文章的结论是，尽管司法审查将更加严格地审视机构的法定授权与监管影响分析背后实质政策之间的兼容性，但监管国家能够——而且必须——不断演进，否则将面临僵化的风险。

title: Viscusi Circular A-4 Peer Review Comments and Guidance for Future Revisions

Valuing Heat-Related Mortality Risks
abstract: Heat-related mortality risks are a substantial component of the looming costs of climate change in the United States and globally. This article presents the results from a risk-risk survey to test whether U.S. respondents place a valuation premium on mortality risks from heat relative to cancer and transportation risks. The questionnaire exploits exogenous shocks to temperatures during a heat wave and randomized elements to further test whether preferences vary with heat exposure or the age of individuals exposed to heat risks. The results provide strong evidence that there is no valuation premium in the U.S. for heat-related risks. Subjects valued cancer risks twice as highly as heat and transportation risks, the latter of which are a common benchmark for general traumatic fatalities. While there is some evidence that subjects value heat risks more when exposed to a heat shock of approximately 3–4 °C, the size of the differential is too small to establish a statistically significant heat risk premium. Finally, subjects’ responses demonstrate no differential valuation of mortality risks to seniors versus the general population based on the preferences of the general population or the senior subsample.
abstract_zh: 与热相关的死亡风险是美国乃至全球气候变化迫近成本的重要组成部分。本文介绍了一项风险对风险调查的结果，以检验美国受访者是否对热相关死亡风险相对于癌症风险和交通风险给予额外的价值溢价。问卷利用热浪期间气温的外生冲击，并纳入随机化设计，以进一步检验偏好是否随暴露于热的程度或个体年龄而变化。结果有力地表明，美国人对热相关风险不存在价值溢价。受访者对癌症风险的评价是热风险和交通风险的两倍，而交通风险通常是一般创伤性死亡的常见基准。虽然有一些证据表明，当受试者经历约3–4°C的热冲击时会更重视热风险，但这一差异太小，无法确立统计上显著的热风险溢价。最后，基于一般人群偏好或老年人子样本的结果，受试者对老年人与一般人群死亡风险的估值没有表现出差异。

A Balanced Prescription for More Effective Environmental Regulations
abstract: Government agencies increasingly base the structure and approval of environmental regulations on a benefit-cost test. For regulations that pass this test, total benefits exceed total costs. Under a benefit-cost framework, the degree of regulatory stringency is set at an economically efficient level whereby the tightness of the regulation is increased up to the point where the incremental benefits equal the incremental costs. Setting regulatory standards to achieve the efficient degree of pollution control does not fully discourage entry into polluting industries, provide compensation to those harmed by pollution, or establish meaningful incentives for effective enforcement. This article proposes that the benefit-cost approach be retained as the guiding principle for regulatory policy, but that sanctions for regulatory violations be greatly enhanced. A different, more ambitious proposal by Elliott and Esty advocates pollution control to the lowest level that is technologically feasible, coupled with compensation for those injured by pollution. The unbounded regulatory framework advocated by Elliott and Esty sets aside benefit-cost balancing, generating the prospect of inordinate costs with few environmental dividends from the highest levels of stringency. Their more promising proposal is to establish a compensation system for environmental harms. Compensation for those harmed by pollution has some parallels with successful workers’ compensation programs, but to be successful it must address challenges not faced in the employment context. More stringent regulation of long-term risks may be more welfare-enhancing for future generations than their proposed environmental damages compensation fund. Protection may yield greater dividends for more affluent future generations than compensation.
abstract_zh: 政府机构越来越多地以效益—成本检验为基础来确定环境法规的结构和批准。对于通过该检验的法规，总收益超过总成本。在效益—成本框架下，监管的严格程度被设定在经济上有效率的水平，即监管的严格程度不断提高，直至增量收益等于增量成本为止。将监管标准设定为实现有效率的污染控制水平，并不能充分阻止进入污染性行业，不能为受污染伤害者提供补偿，也无法为有效执法建立有意义的激励。本文建议，应保留效益—成本方法作为监管政策的指导原则，但应大幅加强对违规行为的制裁。Elliott和Esty提出了一个更为激进的方案，主张将污染控制到技术上可行的最低水平，并对受污染伤害者进行补偿。Elliott和Esty所倡导的无界限监管框架搁置了效益—成本权衡，可能导致成本过高而最严格的监管水平却只带来很少的环境红利。他们更有前景的建议是建立环境损害补偿制度。对污染受害者的补偿与成功的工伤补偿计划有一些相似之处，但要取得成功，它必须应对就业情境中不存在的挑战。相比他们提议的环境损害补偿基金，对长期风险进行更严格的监管，可能对后代的福利更有益。对于更富裕的后代而言，保护所带来的红利可能比补偿更大。

title: Changes in Household Recycling Behavior: Evidence from Panel Data
abstract: This article analyzes changes in recycling behavior using a longitudinal national U.S. dataset with over 235,000 pairs of same-household observations to measure changes in recycling behavior. Changes in recycling are greater if others in the county increased their recycling rates.  Policies that encourage recycling through changes in deposit laws, more stringent state recycling laws, or new availability of single-stream recycling also increase recycling. There are increased recycling rates for cans, glass, and plastic when the market prices for the returned materials increase. Some shocks to the household can diminish recycling, including marriage, the arrival of a newborn, and either large positive or large negative changes in income. Political factors are also consequential, as recycling declines if the state legislature becomes Republican. The estimates for the total number of materials that a household recycles and the recycling of particular materials follow similar patterns.
abstract_zh: 本文利用美国全国性纵向数据集分析家庭回收行为的变化，该数据集包含超过235,000对同一家庭的观测值，用以衡量回收行为的变化。如果县内其他人提高了回收率，该家庭的回收变化也更大。通过改变押金法、实施更严格的州回收法规，或引入单流回收（single-stream recycling）服务的政策，同样能够提高回收率。当回收材料的市场价格上涨时，罐装物、玻璃和塑料的回收率也会提高。家庭中的某些冲击会降低回收行为，包括结婚、新生儿出生，以及收入的大幅增加或大幅减少。政治因素也具有重要影响：若州议会转由共和党控制，回收率就会下降。关于家庭回收材料总数以及特定材料回收情况的估计结果，呈现出相似的模式。

Seven Recommendations for Pricing Greenhouse Gas Emissions
abstract: The social cost of greenhouse gases is important in many regulatory impact analyses. However, calculations of the social cost of greenhouse gases are highly complex and periodically revisited. We offer seven recommendations to improve current estimates. These include recommendations to use both country-level and global measures of the social cost of greenhouse gases, to use country-specific values for monetizing climate damages, to represent uncertainties by reporting distributions instead of using only central values, and to conduct a temporal distributional analysis that shows the magnitudes of climate damages across generations. We also provide recommendations for the discount rates that should be used when estimating the social cost of greenhouse gases, and the appropriate discount rates for regulatory impact analyses that include the social cost of greenhouse gases.
abstract_zh: 温室气体的社会成本在许多监管影响分析中都很重要。然而，温室气体社会成本的计算高度复杂，并且需要定期重新审视。我们提出了七项建议以改进现有估计。这些建议包括：同时使用国家层面和全球层面的温室气体社会成本指标；使用国别特定值来货币化气候损害；通过报告分布而非仅使用中心值来表示不确定性；以及开展时间维度的分布分析，展示不同代际之间的气候损害规模。我们还就估算温室气体社会成本时应采用的贴现率，以及包含温室气体社会成本的监管影响分析应采用的适当贴现率，提出了建议。

Quasi-Experimental Evidence on the Impact of State Recycling and Deposit Laws: Household Recycling Following Interstate Moves
abstract: This article estimates the effects on recycling behavior of state recycling laws and deposit laws based on changes in household recycling before and after interstate moves. Estimates from a national panel dataset of 1,498 households who moved between states provide a quasi-experimental test otherwise not possible given long-term stability of such laws in any state. Compared to national average recycling rates, moves to states with deposits for beverage containers increased the number of material types recycled by 41%. More stringent recycling laws are also effective, but they have a smaller impact. Recycling laws boosted the number of materials recycled by 9%, with the largest effect being the 17% increase in the recycling rate for glass. Moves from states with deposit laws to states without such laws decreased the number of materials recycled by 13%. Shifts out of states with stringent laws only had statistically significant effects for plastic, which exhibited a 12% decrease after such a move.
abstract_zh: 本文基于家庭在跨州搬迁前后回收行为的变化，估计了州回收法和押金法对回收行为的影响。来自全国性面板数据集中1,498户跨州搬迁家庭的估计结果，提供了一项准实验检验，而由于各州此类法律长期保持稳定，这一检验在其他情况下是无法进行的。与全国平均回收率相比，搬迁到对饮料容器实行押金制的州后，家庭回收的材料种类增加了41%。更严格的回收法规同样有效，但其影响较小。回收法规使回收材料的种类增加了9%，其中影响最大的是玻璃，其回收率提高了17%。从实行押金法的州搬到未实行此类法律的州后，家庭回收的材料种类减少了13%。从严格法规州搬离的情况，仅对塑料产生了统计上显著的影响，搬离后塑料回收量下降了12%。

title: The Broad Impacts of Disposable Lighter Safety Regulations
The Hierarchy and Performance of State Recycling and Deposit Laws
abstract: States can foster recycling of waste materials through a variety of policies. The majority of the states have recycling laws for waste products such as glass, plastic, cans, and paper. These laws vary in terms of stringency. The hierarchy we developed orders the laws as follows: laws that make recycling mandatory, laws that require the provision of recycling opportunities, laws that require the development of a recycling plan, and laws that specify a recycling goal. Based on national recycling data with over 400,000 observations, we find that the amount of recycling households undertake increases with the degree of stringency of the legal structure. Other legal recycling initiatives consist of laws that have established deposit policies, which a minority of states have done. Deposit policies establish financial incentives to promote recycling. States with deposit policies exhibit higher recycling rates for glass, plastic, and cans than states that have not enacted such laws. The higher recycling rates, for paper in the bottle deposit states, may reflect a broader impact of deposit policies on households’ recycling behavior for products not covered by the deposits.
abstract_zh: 各州可以通过多种政策促进废弃物材料的回收。大多数州都针对玻璃、塑料、罐装物和纸张等废弃物制定了回收法规，这些法规的严格程度各不相同。我们提出的层级体系按以下顺序对法规进行排序：强制回收的法规、要求提供回收渠道的法规、要求制定回收计划的法规，以及规定回收目标的法规。基于超过400,000条观测值的全国回收数据，我们发现，家庭的回收量随法律结构严格程度的提高而增加。其他回收相关举措包括押金政策，只有少数州实施了此类政策。押金政策通过经济激励促进回收。实行押金政策的州，其玻璃、塑料和罐装物的回收率高于未立法的州。在实行瓶装押金的州，纸张回收率较高，这可能反映了押金政策对押金所不覆盖的其他产品的家庭回收行为产生了更广泛的影响。

The Dynamic Relationships between Social Norms and Pro-Environmental Behavior: Evidence from Household Recycling
abstract: Social norms are strongly associated with pro-environmental behaviors, but the evolution and dynamic effects of norms are less well understood. This article builds on the distinction of norms being descriptive, characterizing what people actually do, or injunctive, characterizing what people should do. It identifies four categories of norms with the further distinction of whether the norms arise from the personal beliefs and actions or from the behaviors and judgments of others. The analysis uses five years of longitudinal US data that track household recycling and controls for household characteristics as well as differences in state recycling laws. The results extend previous research by showing that personal norms exhibit cascading dynamics in which norms encourage later changes in recycling, while recycling encourages later changes in personal norms. This mutual reinforcement implies that societal actions encouraging change in either personal norms or recycling will support growth in the other. Recognizing this interdependence can assist in the effective utilization of social norms as a behavioral policy instrument.
abstract_zh: 社会规范与亲环境行为密切相关，但规范的演变及其动态效应尚不为人们充分理解。本文以规范的描述性与命令性区分为基础：描述性规范刻画人们实际上做什么，命令性规范刻画人们应当做什么。文章进一步根据规范源自个人信念与行为，还是源自他人的行为与判断，划分出四类规范。分析使用了五年的美国纵向数据，这些数据追踪家庭回收行为，并控制了家庭特征以及各州回收法规的差异。研究结果扩展了以往的研究：个人规范呈现出级联式的动态，即规范会促使之后的回收行为发生变化，而回收行为也会促使之后的个人规范发生变化。这种相互强化意味着，鼓励个人规范或回收行为发生变化的社会行动，将推动另一方的增长。认识到这种相互依赖关系，有助于有效地将社会规范用作行为政策工具。

title: The Impact of Cannabis Access Laws on Opioid Prescribing
The Perception and Excessive Valuation of Small, Publicized Drinking Water Risks
abstract: Low probability risks create challenges for individual decisions and potential pressures for government regulation. This article reports original survey evidence regarding the public’s perception and valuation of water-related risks from plastic bottles with bisphenol A, residues in drinking water of the herbicide atrazine, and trace amounts of prescription drugs in water. People who believe that they face high water-related risks generally believe that the risks apply and, given that belief, are willing to pay more to limit the risk. However, the expressed willingness to pay for risk reductions is inordinately high even among those who are unsure of whether they are even exposed to the risk, and therefore may not be reliable as values for the actual benefits.
abstract_zh: 低概率风险给个人决策带来挑战，也可能对政府监管形成压力。本文报告了关于公众对与饮用水相关风险的认知和估价的原始调查证据，这些风险涉及含双酚A的塑料瓶、饮用水中残留的除草剂莠去津，以及水中痕量的处方药。认为自己面临较高水相关风险的人，大体上相信这些风险确实存在，并且基于这一信念，愿意为降低风险支付更多费用。然而，即使是那些不确定自己是否真正暴露于该风险之中的人，其表示愿意为降低风险支付的金额也高得不成比例，因此这些数值可能不足以作为实际收益的可靠估值。

Responsible Precautions for Uncertain Environmental Risks
abstract: Uncertain future risks pose cognitive and analytical challenges to household decision makers. Risks with uncertain probabilities, coupled with potentially severe outcomes pose problems for decision-making and are prone to overreactions. Imprecision in risk estimates generates behavioral distortions such as ambiguity aversion. This article presents new empirical results indicating household overvaluations of uncertain threats posed by several drinking water risks: traces of prescription drugs in drinking water, plastic water bottles with bisphenol-A, and the weed killer atrazine in drinking water. Negative reactions reflect responses to ambiguous risks, but policies driven by these concerns may misallocate regulatory resources due to risk conservatism and “no-regrets” responses.
abstract_zh: 不确定的未来风险给家庭决策者带来了认知和分析上的挑战。发生概率不确定、且可能产生严重后果的风险，给决策带来了难题，并容易引发过度反应。风险估计的不精确性会导致行为扭曲，例如模糊规避。本文提供了新的实证结果，表明家庭对饮用水中若干不确定威胁存在过度评价，这些威胁包括：饮用水中痕量的处方药、含双酚A的塑料水瓶，以及饮用水中的除草剂莠去津。这些负面反应反映了对模糊风险的回应，而受这些担忧驱动的政策可能因风险保守主义和“无悔”式反应而错配监管资源。

Fostering Recycling Participation in Wisconsin Households through Single-Stream Programs
abstract: Single-stream recycling enables households to recycle an unsorted mix of cans, plastic, glass, and paper, thereby reducing recycling costs. The expansion of single-stream recycling in Wisconsin provides a natural experiment to assess the extent to which single-stream increases recycling behavior. Using a longitudinal database that matches household recycling participation to county-level recycling policies from Wisconsin, we identify respondent and county characteristics that promote recycling. The results of both fixed effects regressions and a differences-in-differences analysis demonstrate that single-stream programs increase recycling within households. The shift from dual to single-stream has benefits exceeding costs.
abstract_zh: 单流回收使家庭能够将未经分类的罐装物、塑料、玻璃和纸张混合投放，从而降低回收成本。威斯康星州单流回收的推广为评估单流回收在多大程度上提高回收行为提供了一次自然实验。利用一个将家庭回收参与情况与威斯康星州县级回收政策相匹配的纵向数据库，我们识别出促进回收的受访者特征和县级特征。固定效应回归与双重差分分析的结果均表明，单流计划提高了家庭内部的回收率。从双流转向单流的收益超过了成本。

Determining the Proper Scope of Climate Change Policy Benefits in U.S. Regulatory Analyses: Domestic versus Global Approaches
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Although benefit assessment principles are well established for specific populations, very little attention has been paid to how to define the scope of the pertinent population for such assessments. Whose social welfare matters and whose benefits should be included in the assessment? In the case of U.S. regulatory policies, the norm has been to assess the benefits to U.S. citizens. However, in 2010, the Obama Administration’s Interagency Working Group on Social Cost of Carbon adopted a global perspective on assessing the benefits associated with reductions in carbon dioxide emissions. This article examines whether U.S. policymakers should assess the benefits of climate change policies from a domestic or a global perspective. Drawing from executive orders and the laws governing risk and environmental regulations, we review the norms used for the scope of benefit assessments. Then we examine specific examples of the use of the global approach to benefit assessments of carbon dioxide reductions for energy efficiency regulations. We also compare the U.S. approach to that of other developed countries. Finally, we discuss how reciprocity should be incorporated into global benefits within a benefit-cost framework, and the role of altruism in considering the proper scope of benefits.
abstract_zh: 尽管针对特定人群的收益评估原则已经相当成熟，但人们很少关注如何界定此类评估中相关人群的范围。谁的社会福利重要？哪些人的收益应纳入评估？在美国的监管政策中，通行的做法是评估美国公民的收益。然而，2010年，奥巴马政府的社会碳成本跨部门工作组采用了全球视角来评估减少二氧化碳排放所带来的收益。本文考察美国政策制定者在评估气候变化政策收益时应采用国内视角还是全球视角。依据行政命令以及管理风险和环境监管的法律，我们回顾了收益评估范围所遵循的规范。随后，我们考察了在评估能源效率法规的二氧化碳减排收益时采用全球方法的具体案例。我们还将美国的做法与其他发达国家进行了比较。最后，我们讨论了如何在收益—成本框架中将互惠性纳入全球收益，以及利他主义在界定收益范围中的作用。

abstract: We find “green” labels increase residential property values by an average of 5%. This premium varies by label stringency and across market segments. Builders respond to the stringency of labels by strategically incorporating green features to achieve higher ratings. This strategy seems reasonable as there is no market premium for green features that lead to scores between label rating cutoff values. These results raise important questions as to how green label policies should be designed in order to foster the supply of green features. Gradations of green attributes are influential, particularly for highly rated homes. The most stringent labels have the greatest role at the high price end of the market. (JEL Q20, Q40, R31)
abstract_zh: 我们发现，“绿色”标签平均使住宅房产价值提高5%。这一溢价因标签的严格程度以及细分市场而异。开发商会根据标签的严格程度，有策略地纳入绿色特征，以获得更高的评级。这一策略看似合理，因为对于得分落在标签评级门槛值之间的绿色特征，市场并不给予溢价。这些结果引发了重要问题：应如何设计绿色标签政策，以促进绿色特征的供给。绿色属性的细微分级具有影响力，对于高评级住房尤其如此。最严格的标签在高价位市场中作用最大。（JEL Q20, Q40, R31）

The Private Rationality of Bottled Water Drinking
abstract: This article examines evidence for the private rationality of decisions to choose bottled water using a large, nationally representative sample. Consumers are more likely to believe that bottled water is safer or tastes better if they have had adverse experiences with tap water or live in states with more prevalent violations of EPA water quality standards. Perceptions of superior safety, taste, and convenience of bottled water boost consumption of bottled water. Blacks and Hispanics are more likely to drink bottled water due to their relatively greater exposure to unsafe water and greater risk beliefs. The coherent network of experiences, beliefs, and actions is consistent with rational consumer choice.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一个大型的全国代表性样本，考察了选择瓶装水这一决策的私人理性证据。如果消费者曾有过自来水的负面体验，或居住在EPA水质标准违规较为普遍的州，他们更有可能相信瓶装水更安全或口感更好。对瓶装水安全性、口感和便利性的优越感知会促进瓶装水的消费。黑人和西班牙裔更有可能饮用瓶装水，原因在于他们相对更多地接触不安全的饮用水，并且其风险信念也更强。经验、信念与行为所构成的这一连贯网络，与理性的消费者选择是一致的。

title: The Relative Weights of Direct and Indirect Experiences in the Formation of Environmental Risk Beliefs
abstract: Direct experiences, we find, influence environmental risk beliefs more than the indirect experiences derived from outcomes to others. This disparity could have a rational basis. Or it could be based on behavioral proclivities in accord with the well‐established availability heuristic or the vested‐interest heuristic, which we introduce in this article. Using original data from a large, nationally representative sample, this article examines the perception of, and responses to, morbidity risks from tap water. Direct experiences have a stronger and more consistent effect on different measures of risk belief. Direct experiences also boost the precautionary response of drinking bottled water and drinking filtered water, while indirect experiences do not. These results are consistent with the hypothesized neglect of indirect experiences in other risk contexts, such as climate change.
abstract_zh: 我们发现，直接经验对环境风险信念的影响大于源自他人结果的间接经验。这种差异可能有理性基础，也可能源于行为上的倾向，例如广为人知的可得性启发式（availability heuristic），或本文提出的既得利益启发式（vested-interest heuristic）。本文利用一项来自全国代表性大样本的原始数据，考察了人们对自来水所致发病风险的感知及其应对反应。直接经验对不同风险信念测度的影响更强、也更为一致。直接经验还会增强人们饮用瓶装水和过滤水的预防性反应，而间接经验则没有这一作用。这些结果与其他风险情境（如气候变化）中间接经验被忽视的假说相一致。

abstract: This article uses a large, original data set on U.S. recycling behavior and perception of social norms. The data include unique information with respect to personal norms and external social norms with respect to recycling behavior, making it possible to analyze the determinants of these norms and the effect of norms on recycling. The legal and regulatory environment affect average community recycling rates and external social norms, but do not have an additional independent effect on recycling for glass, plastic, cans, or paper. Social norms in terms of average community recycling rates and perceived external norms boost recycling rates. Households that recycle are also more likely to have a private recycling norm. Deposit policies that provide financial incentives and recycling policies that make recycling more convenient boost recycling rates.
abstract_zh: 本文使用了一个大型原创数据集，内容涉及美国居民的回收行为及其对社会规范的感知。该数据包含关于回收行为的个人规范与外部社会规范的独特信息，使我们能够分析这些规范的决定因素以及规范对回收的影响。法律和监管环境会影响社区平均回收率和外部社会规范，但对玻璃、塑料、罐装物或纸张的回收并不产生额外的独立影响。以社区平均回收率和感知到的外部规范衡量的社会规范会提高回收率。进行回收的家庭也更有可能形成私人回收规范。提供经济激励的押金政策，以及使回收更为便利的回收政策，都能提高回收率。

Discontinuous Behavioral Responses to Recycling Laws and Plastic Water Bottle Deposits
abstract: Economic theory predicts that individual recycling behavior gravitates toward extremes-either diligent recycling or no recycling at all. Using a nationally representative sample of 3,158 bottled water users, this article finds that this prediction is borne out for consumer recycling of plastic water bottles. Both water bottle deposits and recycling laws foster recycling through a discontinuous effect that converts reluctant recyclers into diligent recyclers. Within this context, a number of factors influencing recycling emerge. The warm glow from being both an environmentalist and an environmental group member is about equal to the monetary value of 5 cent bottle deposits. Respondents from states with stringent recycling laws and bottle deposits have greater recycling rates. Consistent with recycling being a threshold response, the efficacy of these policy interventions is greater for those who do not already recycle, have lower income, and do not consider themselves to be environmentalists.
abstract_zh: 经济理论预测，个体的回收行为会趋于两极，要么认真回收，要么完全不回收。本文利用一个具有全国代表性的3,158名瓶装水用户样本，发现这一预测在消费者对塑料水瓶的回收中得到了印证。瓶装水押金和回收法规都通过一种不连续效应促进回收，即把原本不情愿回收的人转变为认真的回收者。在这一背景下，若干影响回收的因素得以显现。同时身为环保主义者和环保团体成员所带来的“暖融感”（warm glow），其货币价值约等于5美分瓶装押金的价值。来自回收法规严格且实行瓶装押金的州的受访者，回收率更高。与回收属于阈值式反应相一致，这些政策干预对于那些原本不回收、收入较低且不认为自己是环保主义者的人，效果更为显著。

title: Overriding Consumer Preferences with Energy Regulations

Alternative Policies to Increase Recycling of Plastic Water Bottles in the United States
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Using an original, nationally representative sample of plastic water bottle users, this article examines the efficacy of policy mechanisms to foster increased recycling. In particular, it examines the impact of the stringency of a state’s laws on the availability of recycling opportunities such as the availability of recycling centers or curbside pickups. As a result, household level data controlling for the particular recycling legal regime and the state’s bottle deposit policy demonstrates that there is a positive effect on recycling from mandated separation of recyclables, the availability of a recycling center in the community, and the provision of curbside pickup at houses or recycling locations at apartments. Further, we show that recycling opportunities compensate for each other. For example, deposits for plastic water bottles and recycling centers increase recycling rates, although their impact becomes less pronounced if curbside pickups are available. Moreover, the efficacy of these policies exhibits a discontinuous effect, characterized by a jump in the household behavioral response as effective laws transform non-recyclers into diligent recyclers. Most of these findings are associational, but, examining two states which changed their deposit laws demonstrates that changes in recycling behavior can be generated by changes in recycling laws.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一个原创的、具有全国代表性的塑料水瓶用户样本，考察了促进回收率提高的政策机制的效果。具体而言，本文考察了一个州法律的严格程度对回收机会（如回收中心或路边收集服务的可得性）的影响。因此，在控制了特定回收法律制度和该州瓶装押金政策的家庭层面数据显示：强制分类回收、社区中设有回收中心，以及在住宅提供路边收集服务或在公寓设置回收点，都对回收产生正向影响。此外，我们发现回收机会之间存在相互补偿的关系。例如，塑料水瓶押金和回收中心都能提高回收率，但若提供路边收集服务，其影响则变得不那么显著。而且，这些政策的效果呈现不连续性，即随着有效法律将不回收者转变为认真的回收者，家庭行为反应会出现跳跃。这些发现大多属于相关性结论，但通过考察两个变更了押金法律的州，表明回收法律的变化能够引起回收行为的改变。

title: Heterogeneity in Values of Morbidity Risks from Drinking Water
abstract: This paper reports the stated preference values for reducing the morbidity risks from drinking water estimated using a nationally representative U.S. sample of 3,585 households. Based on the average annual gastrointestinal (GI) illness risk in the U.S. from drinking water of about 5 illnesses per 100 population, eliminating the GI risk has a median annual value per household of $219. The considerable heterogeneity in the values arises largely from differences in attitudes towards risk and price sensitivity. Using interval regressions, we find that valuations are greater for those who perceive a high personal risk, consume a large quantity of tap water, or are environmentalists. The paper explores several methodological issues pertaining to the iterative choice format involving a choice between two policies characterized by their cost and GI risk. The analysis adjusts for starting point effects by basing valuations on the tradeoffs that are estimated to prevail at the “equitable tradeoff rate,” which is the starting cost-water quality tradeoff rate that produces a 50-50 split in the initial policy choice between policies with greater tradeoff rates and policies with lower tradeoff rates. The heterogeneity in valuations is also explored by examining quantile regression results and the determinants of the unbounded valuation amounts at the low and high extremes.
abstract_zh: 本文报告了基于美国一个具有全国代表性的3,585户家庭样本，估计出的减少饮用水相关发病风险的陈述偏好价值。根据美国因饮用水导致的年均胃肠道（GI）疾病风险约为每百人5例，消除胃肠道风险的家庭年均价值中位数为219美元。价值存在较大异质性，主要源于风险态度和价格敏感性的差异。利用区间回归，我们发现，认为自身个人风险较高、饮用大量自来水或属于环保主义者的人，其估值更高。本文探讨了与迭代选择格式相关的若干方法论问题，该格式要求受访者在两项以成本和胃肠道风险为特征的政策之间进行选择。分析中通过以“公平权衡率”下估计得到的权衡关系为基础计算估值，来调整起始点效应。“公平权衡率”是指使初始政策选择中，权衡率较高的政策与权衡率较低的政策各占50%的起始成本—水质权衡率。此外，本文还通过考察分位数回归结果，以及极低和极高端无界估值金额的决定因素，探讨了估值的异质性。

The Role of Information Disclosure in Climate Mitigation Policy
abstract: Information disclosure policies represent an additional policy mechanism that can be used to foster reductions in greenhouse gas emissions. These informational efforts could be either mandatory or voluntary, but in each case government regulation could play a productive role by establishing common structures for the information and providing criteria to ensure the accuracy and credibility of the information. Unlike most previous uses of environmental information disclosure, such as the Toxic Release Inventory and pesticide warnings, carbon footprint labeling does not communicate information about immediate private benefits. While considerable insight can be gleaned by examining the principles for effective warnings generally, additional research would further our understanding of how to best design a successful information effort directed at varied future environmental benefits. Care is needed as green labeling may distort consumer decisions if undue prominence is given to environmental consequences as compared to other valued attributes, such as safety.
abstract_zh: 信息披露政策是可用于推动温室气体减排的另一种政策机制。这些信息举措可以是强制性的，也可以是自愿性的，但在任何一种情形下，政府监管都能通过确立信息的统一结构，并提供确保信息准确性与可信度的标准，发挥积极作用。与以往多数环境信息披露的用途（如有毒物质排放清单和农药警示）不同，碳足迹标签并不传递即时的私人收益信息。虽然通过考察有效警示的一般原则可以获得相当多的启示，但若要更好地理解如何针对多样且长期的环境效益设计成功的信息举措，仍需进一步研究。需谨慎对待：若与安全等其他被看重的属性相比，环境后果被过分突出，绿色标签可能会扭曲消费者决策。

abstract: Evidence from a nationally representative sample of households illuminates the determinants of recycling behavior for plastic water bottles. Private values of the environment are influential in promoting recycling, as are personal norms for pro-environmental behavior. However, social norms with respect to the assessment of the household's recycling behaviors by others have little independent effect. Particularly influential are policies that create economic incentives to promote recycling either through state recycling laws that reduce the time and inconvenience costs of recycling or through bottle deposits. Effective policies can have a discontinuous effect at the individual level, transforming non-recyclers into avid recyclers.
abstract_zh: 来自具有全国代表性的家庭样本的证据，揭示了塑料水瓶回收行为的决定因素。对环境的私人价值，以及亲环境行为的个人规范，对促进回收都有重要作用。然而，他人对家庭回收行为进行评价的社会规范，几乎没有独立影响。尤其有影响力的是那些创造经济激励的政策：通过降低回收的时间与不便成本的州回收法律，或瓶装押金制度。有效的政策可以在个体层面产生不连续效应，将不回收者转变为热心的回收者。

abstract: This article evaluates the effect of the choice of survey recruitment mode on the value of water quality in lakes, rivers, and streams. Four different modes are compared: bringing respondents to one central location after phone recruitment, mall intercepts in two states, national phone-mail survey, and an Internet survey with a national, probability-based panel. The modes differ in terms of the representativeness of the samples, non-response rates, sample selection effects, and consistency of responses. The article also shows that the estimated value of water quality can differ substantially depending on the survey mode. The national Internet panel has the most desirable properties with respect to performance on the four important survey dimensions of interest.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了调查招募方式的选择对湖泊、河流和溪流水质价值评估的影响。比较了四种不同的方式：电话招募后将受访者集中到一个中心地点；在两个州的商场拦截访问；全国性的电话—邮件调查；以及基于全国概率样本小组的互联网调查。这些方式在样本的代表性、无应答率、样本选择效应以及回答的一致性方面存在差异。本文还表明，水质的估计价值会因调查方式的不同而有显著差异。在四个重要的调查维度上，全国互联网小组表现出最为理想的特性。

abstract: This article provides a response to the opponents of monetization of risk and environmental benefits, such as the authors of "Priceless: On Knowing the Price of Everything and the Value of Nothing." Putting benefit values in dollar terms ensures that there will be full recognition of these benefits in the policy evaluation process, and also places them on terms comparable to program costs. Much of the article is devoted to advocating the use of the value of statistical life to value health risk reductions from government regulations. The article explores sensitive issues such as the heterogeneity of the value of statistical life with respect to income and age. While the use of a "senior discount" was controversial and involved too great of a discount, there is substantial evidence that there are age variations in the value of statistical life. The article also advocates the continued use of stated preference approaches to valuing environmental benefits, which is in contrast to the critiques of stated preference analyses by those who consider environmental resources to be priceless and by those who believe that all non-use values of environmental benefits are zero.
abstract_zh: 本文回应了那些反对风险和环境效益货币化的人，例如《Priceless: On Knowing the Price of Everything and the Value of Nothing》（《无价：论知晓万物之价而不知其价值》）一书的作者。以美元计量效益，能确保这些效益在政策评估过程中得到充分认可，也使其与项目成本具有可比性。本文大部分内容致力于倡导使用统计生命价值（VSL）来衡量政府管制所带来的健康风险降低。本文探讨了一些敏感议题，例如统计生命价值在收入和年龄上的异质性。尽管“老年折扣”的使用存在争议，且折扣幅度过大，但有大量证据表明统计生命价值确实存在年龄差异。本文还主张继续使用陈述偏好方法评估环境效益，这与那些认为环境资源无价的人，以及认为所有环境效益的非使用价值均为零的人，对陈述偏好分析的批评形成了对比。

title: National Survey Evidence on Disasters and Relief: Risk Beliefs, Self-Interest, and Compassion
The Catastrophic Effects of Natural Disasters on Insurance Markets
abstract: Natural catastrophes often have catastrophic risks on insurance companies as well as on the insured. Using a very large dataset on homeowners' insurance coverage by state, by firm, and by year for the 1984 to 2004 period, this paper documents the positive effect on losses and loss ratios of both unexpected catastrophes as well as large events that the authors term "blockbuster catastrophes."Insurers adapt to these catastrophic risks by raising insurance rates, leading to lower loss ratios after the catastrophic event. There is a widespread event of unexpected catastrophes and blockbuster catastrophes that reduces total premiums earned in the state, reduces the total number writing insurance coverage in the state, and leads to the exit of firms from the state. Firms with low levels of homeowners' premiums are most adversely affected by the catastrophes.
abstract_zh: 自然灾害往往对保险公司和投保人都造成灾难性风险。本文利用1984至2004年间按州、按保险公司、按年份统计的房主保险承保数据的超大规模数据集，记录了意外灾害，以及作者称之为“重磅灾害”（blockbuster catastrophes）的大型事件，对赔付额和赔付率的正向影响。保险公司通过提高保险费率来应对这些灾害风险，导致灾后赔付率下降。意外灾害和重磅灾害普遍存在，它们会减少该州的已赚保费总额，减少在该州承保保险的公司数量，并导致企业退出该州市场。房主保费水平较低的公司受到的不利影响最大。

title: The Generational Divide in Support for Environmental Policies: European Evidence
abstract: This article examines age variations in support for environmental protection policies that affect climate change using a sample of over 14,000 respondents to a 1999 Eurobarometer survey. There is a steady decline with age in whether respondents are willing to incur higher gasoline prices to protect the environment. This relationship remains after controlling for socioeconomic characteristics. There are age-related differences in information about environmental risks, information sources about the environment, perceived health risks from climate change, and degree of worry about climate change. However, taking these factors into account does not eliminate the age variation in willingness to pay more for gasoline to protect the environment.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1999年欧洲晴雨表（Eurobarometer）调查中14,000多名受访者的样本，考察了支持影响气候变化的环境保护政策的年龄差异。受访者是否愿意承担更高的汽油价格以保护环境，随年龄增长呈稳步下降趋势。在控制社会经济特征后，这一关系依然存在。在环境风险信息、环境信息来源、对气候变化所感知的健康风险，以及对气候变化的担忧程度方面，不同年龄段之间存在差异。然而，将这些因素纳入考虑，并不能消除在为保护环境而愿意支付更高汽油价格的意愿上的年龄差异。

title: The Perception and Valuation of the Risks of Climate Change: A Rational and Behavioral Blend
abstract: Over 250 respondents--graduate students in law and public policy--assessed the risks of climate change and valued climate-change mitigation policies. Many aspects of their behavior were consistent with rational behavior. For example, respondents successfully estimated distributions of temperature increases in Boston by 2100.The median value of best estimates was 1-3 degrees Fahrenheit. In addition, people with higher risk estimates, whether for temperature or related risks (e.g., hurricane intensities) offered more to avoid warming. Median willingness to pay (WTP) to avoid global warming was $0.50/gallon, and 3% of income. And important scope tests (e.g., respondents paid more for bigger accomplishments) were passed. However, significant behavioral propensities also emerged. For example, accessibility of neutral information on global warming boosted risk estimates. Warming projections correlated with estimates for unrelated risks, such as earthquakes and heart attacks. The implied WTP for avoidance was much greater when asked as a percent of income than as a gas tax, a percent thinking bias. Home team betting showed itself; individuals predicting a Bush victory predicted smaller temperature increases. In the climate-change arena, behavioral decision tendencies are like a fun-house mirror: They magnify some estimates and shrink others, but the contours of rational decision remain recognizable.
abstract_zh: 250多名受访者（均为法学和公共政策专业的研究生）评估了气候变化风险，并对气候变化缓解政策进行了估值。他们的许多行为与理性行为相一致。例如，受访者能够成功估计波士顿到2100年的气温升幅分布，其最佳估计值的中位数为华氏1–3度。此外，无论是对气温还是对相关风险（如飓风强度）的估计，风险估计较高的人都愿意为避免变暖而支付更多。避免全球变暖的支付意愿（WTP）中位数为每加仑0.50美元，约占收入的3%。同时，他们也通过了重要的范围检验（例如，受访者为更大的成就支付更多）。然而，也出现了显著的行为倾向。例如，获取关于全球变暖的中性信息，会提高风险估计。变暖预测与地震、心脏病发作等无关风险的估计呈正相关。当以收入百分比而非汽油税的形式询问时，所隐含的规避支付意愿要大得多，这体现为一种百分比偏差。“主场偏好”现象也有所显现：预测布什获胜的人，预测的气温升幅较小。在气候变化领域，行为决策倾向就像哈哈镜：它们放大了某些估计，缩小了另一些估计，但理性决策的轮廓依然清晰可辨。

abstract: This article estimates hedonic price models for automobiles using a data set on almost 3,000 households from the U.S. Department of Energy Residential Transportation Energy Consumption Survey. The standard hedonic models are generalized to recognize the role of discounting of fuel efficiency and safety, yielding an estimated rate of time preference ranging from 11 to 17 percent. This range includes the prevailing rate of interest for car loans in 1988 and is consequently consistent with market rates. Purchasers exhibit an implicit value of life ranging from $2.6 to $3.7 million, which is within the range found in the labor market as well as other market contexts. The model also estimates a significant price effect for auto injury risks and fuel efficiency.
abstract_zh: 本文利用美国能源部《住宅交通能源消费调查》中近3,000户家庭的数据，估计了汽车的享乐价格模型。标准享乐模型经过推广，纳入了对燃油效率和安全性的折现因素，由此估计出的时间偏好率介于11%至17%之间。该区间包含了1988年汽车贷款的市场利率，因此与市场利率相一致。购车者隐含的生命价值在260万至370万美元之间，这一范围与劳动力市场及其他市场环境中的发现相符。该模型还估计出汽车伤害风险和燃油效率存在显著的价格效应。

abstract: This paper assesses the value of the non-global warming externalities associated with energy use. The estimates of the full social cost energy prices based on this “no regrets” approach imply environmental costs that often greatly exceed current tax amounts. The midpoint estimates suggest that the price of coal is most out of line with its efficient level. Natural gas is currently overtaxed, and gasoline is appropriately taxed. There is also a substantial range of uncertainty embodied in the no regrets estimates.
